title: EvidenceRecord
description: One machine-readable implementation-support evidence datum: the outcome of a specific gate case for one card on one axis, at a named commit. support.rs consumes these to derive support values. The generator never invokes arbitrary repository test commands embedded in card data; it consumes emitted reports only. See language-pack-design.md section 9 and plan section 11.3.6.

commit.description: Git OID the gate ran at. Must equal the manifest commit for the result to count toward 'validated'.

case_id.description: Example/case ID exercised by the gate.

observed_diagnostics.description: Diagnostic codes/categories observed (validate/resolve axes; negative-example evidence).

known_gap_ref.description: Reviewed known-gap registry entry that authorizes downgrading an axis to 'unsupported'/'partial' rather than 'unknown'. Required for result 'generic-fallback' and for result 'fail' (see allOf).

justifies.description: The support value this evidence record is offered to justify. When 'unsupported', a reviewed known_gap_ref is mandatory (allOf) — the same evidence bar as generic-fallback.

report_hash.description: Content hash of the emitting report, so evidence is traceable and tamper-evident.

allOf.description: A generic-fallback acceptance can never stand in for a real pass.
Reporting an axis 'unsupported' requires a reviewed known-gap record — the same bar as generic-fallback. A bare 'fail' with no known_gap_ref yields 'unknown', never 'unsupported'.
